title: A family photo
instructions: Zeynep bir aile fotoğrafını anlatıyor. Kimin kim olduğunu ve yerlerini karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: This is a photo of my family at my grandmother's birthday.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: My grandmother is in the middle. She is wearing a purple dress. She is eighty today!

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: On her left is my grandfather. He has white hair and glasses.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: The tall man behind them is my uncle Murat. He lives in Germany.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: The woman with long black hair is not my mother. She is my aunt, Selin.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: My mother is next to her. She has short hair.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: And the little boy with the cake is my cousin, Efe. He's five.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Where am I? I'm not in the photo. I took it!

questions.prompt: What does Zeynep's grandfather look like?
options: He has white hair and glasses.
He is wearing a purple shirt.
questions.feedback: Dedesinin beyaz saçları ve gözlüğü var (white hair and glasses). Mor elbise büyükannesinin.
questions.evidence: He has white hair and glasses.

questions.prompt: Who is the woman with long black hair?
questions.feedback: Uzun siyah saçlı kadın annesi değil (not my mother), teyzesi/halası Selin.

questions.prompt: Why isn't Zeynep in the photo?
questions.feedback: Fotoğrafta yok çünkü fotoğrafı o çekti (I took it).
